Name: Durumi Hut - Harvest Helpers and Bucket Watering
Author: asb3967
Description:
[b]Durumi Hut 1.1.0[/b]
A small Stardew Valley fan mod that adds a Robin-built hut with Durumi helpers, two upgrades, and bucket watering. The original Junimo Hut and the player farmer remain unchanged.

[b]Three building stages[/b]
• Base: up to 2 helpers, doorway-centered radius 6 (13×13 square).
• Upgrade 1: up to 3 helpers, radius 8 (17×17 square).
• Upgrade 2: the same 3 helpers and 17×17 area, plus a small well.
Every stage occupies 3×2 tiles and keeps a 36-slot output chest. The coverage includes the hut itself. Robin offers construction and upgrades without a wizard quest, year or season unlock; normal shop hours and construction schedules still apply.

[b]Actual bucket work[/b]
Durumi fills a bucket at the well, walks to a crop and pours. The soil becomes wet when the pour finishes. A bucket waters 8 targets before refilling. Growing crops, trellis crops, wild seeds and outdoor garden pots in range can be watered. Dead crops, empty soil, already-wet soil and crops that do not need water are skipped. Workers need a reachable standing tile beside the well and crop. There is no instant dawn watering and no extra crew.
Watering works from 6am until 7pm and stops in rain. It is independent of the harvest toggle and can operate in winter or on festival days when living crops need water. Harvesting stops in rain, winter and on traditional festival days, and does not award farming XP.

[b]Costs[/b]
Base: 20,000g + 200 stone + 9 starfruit + 100 fiber; 2 days.
Upgrade 1: 5,000g + 100 wood + 100 stone; 1 day.
Upgrade 2: 10,000g + 200 stone + 5 iron bars + 10 hardwood; 2 days.
Upgrades retain the hut's placement and stored items.

[b]Install[/b]
Requires a purchased copy of Stardew Valley 1.6.15 and SMAPI 4.5.2. For the standard mod ZIP, put the DurumiHut folder in Mods and launch through SMAPI. No Content Patcher is needed.
The optional Windows offline installer bundle creates a separate DurumiHut-Standalone environment alongside the installed game, preserving the original modpack and saves. It starts with a new separate profile. Its guide explains Steam Play integration and restoration. No Stardew game files are included; the installer uses your installed copy locally.

[b]Languages[/b]
English, Korean, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Hungarian, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian and Turkish. The mod follows your game language. These translations are AI-generated; native-speaker review of every language is not claimed.

[b]AI disclosure and credits[/b]
AI-Generated Content: OpenAI Codex and GPT-6 Astra generated and revised the code, translations and documentation. OpenAI's built-in image generation created and edited the hut and character artwork. AI Media: this page's description was generated and revised with AI. Gameplay screenshots are actual game captures. Images labeled AI concept art are illustrations, not in-game graphics or feature evidence.
The uploader supplied the concept, requested behavior and Durumi character setting. Durumi is a 10-year-old androgynous child fan character with a red beret, white hair and loose white/black clothes. This is fan work inspired by the Drami community, not an official collaboration or endorsement.
Stardew Valley: ConcernedApe. SMAPI: Pathoschild and contributors. Native game assets are read from the installed game at runtime and are not redistributed in the mod ZIP.

[b]Scope and removal[/b]
Single-player is the tested scope. Multiplayer and other Junimo overhaul combinations are unverified. The hut uses the same artwork in all seasons, without a separate snowy winter sprite. This mod does not add a town, story or player skin.
To remove it, empty the output chests, demolish all Durumi Huts while the mod is still installed, save a day, then remove Mods/DurumiHut. Do not remove the mod from a save while its buildings are still present.
Source and third-party notices are provided with the release packages. Please ask before redistributing or adapting this fan mod's original assets. Contact the uploader for reproducible issues with your SMAPI log and the circumstances; avoid posting private save data publicly.
